criteria.comparison: verifier-recomputed traversal length equals the submitted crossings_observed
criteria.statement: The crossing count is the one the producer chain presents, not the number of records on disk.

criteria.comparison: set equality against the set derived from the built registry
criteria.statement: The admitted-kind set is the registry declarations that are both status admitted and correctly sealed.

criteria.comparison: per-verdict reason equality against the verifier's own fold over the traversal
criteria.statement: Every refusal carries the reason the stated precedence assigns, first test that fires.

criteria.comparison: position equality of the quota-exhausted refusals
criteria.statement: Quota is spent in chain order, so the quota refusals fall where the chain put them.

criteria.comparison: arithmetic identity over the submitted counts
criteria.statement: Admitted plus refused equals the crossing count and the four refusal counts sum to refused.

criteria.comparison: verdict agreement strictly above the instance-local baseline
criteria.statement: The run does better than a policy that gets every decision right and every reason wrong.

judged: the solution against its reference answer
